hooks.command: diff -q "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/deps/package-lock.json" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/.installed-package-lock.json" >/dev/null 2>&1 || (cd "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}" && cp "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/deps/package.json" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/deps/package-lock.json" . && npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-fund --no-audit && cp package-lock.json .installed-package-lock.json)
